thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall (sara) — realtime-streaming p99 latency breached 2m ago in us-east-1. Alert: p99 > 2.0s, increase compared to baseline. Origin: frontend-proxy -> streaming-ingress.

sara: acknowledged. pulling up the grafana panel now. can someone grab the root cause checklist? :eyes:

ashley: i'm on it. quick check: rolling deploy or config change in last 30m? gitlab shows no deploys to streaming services in last hour.

priya: i'm seeing increased queue depth on streaming-ingress pods — backlog up ~4x. might be batching/kv cache thrash. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/streams/realtime-latency?orgId=1&var-region=us-east-1

monitoring-bot: metric spike summary: p95=0.84s (norm 0.35s), p99=2.45s (norm 0.6s). error rate (5m): 0.3% -> 1.2%. streaming stalls count increased by 300% in the last 10m.

ashley: running quick flame query on ingress pods to check stalls and threadpool queue.

ashley: (paste) 
```kubectl -n streaming exec -it svc/ingress-proxy -- bash -c "curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep 'request_queue_length'"```
queue lengths returning ~120 on several pods (expected <20).

priya: KV cache eviction also spiking, see logs: 
```[2026-03-15T10:05:12Z] WARN kvcache: eviction=high rate=0.87 pods=ingress-4,5,7
[2026-03-15T10:06:01Z] WARN kvcache: miss-rate=0.22```
looks like heavier long-tail sequences causing cache churn.

sara: customer impact? are any VIP customers timing out or seeing 5xx?

monitoring-bot: top impacted routes: /v1/realtime/stream (75% of affected), /v1/chat/stream (20%). Affected customer subset: ~3% of total requests concentrated on two high-throughput tenants (cust-phi, cust-alpha). Error class is mostly 502/504 from ingress timeouts.

ashley: possible short-term mitigations: 1) increase ingress concurrency limit, 2) temporarily disable prefix KV caching for long-tail sequences, 3) add a small pool of warm workers (burst nodes). I'm leaning to (1) + (3) for fastest recovery.

priya: disabling prefix cache might increase token cost but reduce eviction churn — can be toggled per-tenant via feature flag.

sara: do we have a canary run for increasing concurrency? risk is overloading backend.

ashley: runbook suggests incremental +20% concurrency caps per step with monitoring. i can bump ingress `worker_concurrency` from 64 -> 80 on two pods as a pilot.

priya: i'll flip prefix-cache for cust-phi to "local-only" mode (no global eviction) to test.

ashley: i'll execute pilot now on ingress-4 and ingress-5.

ashley: (paste) 
```kubectl -n streaming patch deployment ingress-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"ingress","env":[{"name":"WORKER_CONCURRENCY","value":"80"}]}]}}}}'```

ashley: pilot applied. monitoring watch on grafana panel.

sara: assigning priority: P1. miguel, i'll hand off to you if i'm needed on the customer call. i'm going to open a short incident bridge in 5.

miguel: i'm up — joining. summary pls?

priya: summary: p99 spike caused by queue buildup + kvcache eviction churn affecting a small set of tenants. initial pilots: bump worker_concurrency on 2 pods, toggle prefix-cache for cust-phi.

monitoring-bot: 60s after pilot: p99 dropped from 2.45s -> 1.1s on pilot shard, queue length in ingress-4/5 down to ~30. overall cluster p99 now 1.6s.

ashley: pilot looking good. plan: roll concurrency bump to all ingress pods in us-east-1 in 5-minute rolling windows, monitor error rate.

priya: i've toggled prefix-cache for cust-phi to static-local. will watch miss-rate and cost.

miguel: start rolling now. i'll take second monitor.

ashley: kicked rolling update with concurrency=80 across us-east-1.

ashley: (logs) 
```rolling update: ingress-proxy — 8/8 pods updated (eta ~6m)```

monitoring-bot: mid-roll update: p99=0.95s (cluster), error-rate decreasing toward baseline. streaming stalls metric trending down.

sara: good. customer outreach? ops says cust-phi reported 15% increased latency on session-based flows but no requests dropped after mitigations. recommend a short note to account managers.

miguel: drafting concise incident message: cause, mitigation, impact scope, next steps. will share for ack.

ashley: follow-up items: 1) run a root-cause deeper analysis on KV eviction heuristics, 2) add adaptive concurrency gating to ingress (auto-scale concurrency by queue depth), 3) create an on-call playbook entry for kvcache thrash.

priya: agree. also add per-tenant cache modes to console UI so SEs can toggle without infra ping.

sara: on-call handoff: i'm going offline in 10m. miguel, i'll hand to you with notes: action items, current mitigations in place, pilot results.

miguel: ack. i'm taking over. current status: mitigations rolled, p99 trending toward normal (target <0.8s), monitoring alerts suppressed for rolling operations. i'll keep incident open for RCA and customer follow-up.

incident-bot: incident updated to 'mitigated' (manual) at 4625000360. Incident lead: miguel.

miguel: I'll run post-mortem template and link logs/dashboards. tagging for follow-ups: @engineering-runtime @eng-ml (kvcache heuristics).

sara: thanks team. great quick pivots. :thumbsup:

miguel: leaving notes in the bridge log and will file incident report in postmortems/ after a quick RCA. closing active paging.
